external_model_input.source: original PNG at image_relpath (pixels only; no mask, bbox or metadata)
external_model_input.color: single grayscale channel, 8 bit (mode 'L'); other modes are rejected
external_model_input.geometry: whole image scaled down proportionally to fit (PIL.ImageOps.contain), centred on a black canvas; no crop, no stretch
external_model_input.side_rounding: Pillow rounds the scaled side with Python round() (half to even)
external_model_input.centering: offset = (target - scaled) // 2; an odd remainder lies right/bottom
external_model_input.scaling: float32(uint8) / 255 -> [0, 1]; fixed, nothing estimated from data
external_model_input.flatten: none - the CNN receives the image array, no flattening transformation
external_model_input.note: same external preparation as the small CNN

in_model_transformations.result: (N, 160, 160, 3), three identical channels, no colour information

in_model_transformations.equivalent_to: official MobileNetV2 preprocessing applied to [0, 255] data (x/127.5 - 1)

internal_backbone_input.note: black padding becomes -1; no preprocess_input and no second division by 255

backbone.weights: ImageNet weights as in the accepted frozen checkpoint, further trained on BUS-BRA in step 3B (head) and step 3E (released layers, learning rate 1e-4)
backbone.batchnorm: all 52 layers fully fixed: gamma/beta and moving statistics, and training=False

trainability.fixed: every other backbone weight incl. all BatchNorm variables; GAP and Dropout have no weights
trainability.start_state: accepted frozen checkpoint (best epoch 20): trained head and its backbone, no random re-initialisation; NOT the result of the 3C or 3D fine-tuning
trainability.note: the whole backbone fingerprint may differ from the start; the fixed groups must stay exactly identical

configuration.train_shuffle: tf.data shuffle over the whole train set, seed 42, reshuffled every epoch
configuration.history_counting: fine-tuning epochs counted from 1; not a continuation of the frozen history

evaluation.rule: score >= threshold; no optimisation or calibration

rule.decision: highest unrounded validation ROC-AUC (primary metric of the project definition) among technically valid candidates
rule.tie_rule: candidates within the tolerance below the best value count as tied; the first of them in this order wins: frozen, limited fine-tuning 1e-5, extended fine-tuning 1e-5, extended fine-tuning 1e-4
rule.invalid_candidates: a technically invalid or non-finite candidate cannot be selected; if no candidate is valid there is no winner
rule.missing_predecessor: a missing or hash-mismatching accepted predecessor run stops the step before training
not_used_for_the_decision: sensitivity and all other metrics at threshold 0.5
rule.within_a_run: the checkpoint is the epoch with the smallest validation loss (first one on a tie)
rule.rule_is_not_changed_after_seeing_results: the sensitivity-oriented application goal receives its own, explicitly documented evaluation later; it does not change this historical comparison rule
rule.scope: An exploratory single-seed preference on this holdout only: no stability or significance claim, no best-seed selection, no final model choice for the test phase.

candidate_selection.note_on_threshold_metrics: a higher AUC or lower loss does not guarantee a higher sensitivity at the fixed threshold 0.5
candidate_selection.caveat: An exploratory single-seed comparison: no stability or significance claim, no best-seed selection, no causal claim. Validation was used repeatedly for development, which can make the observed best value optimistic; it is not an independent assessment. Model choice and threshold for the test phase are frozen in a later task. The agreed multi-seed comparison and the sensitivity-oriented threshold study are not part of this step.

group_definitions.batchnorm: all 52 BatchNormalization layers incl. gamma, beta, moving mean/variance
group_definitions.head: output Dense kernel and bias

probe.data: first 16 TRAIN images in stable order

gpu.memory_note: TensorFlow allocator statistics and nvidia-smi values observed in this run; no memory limit was set by the project

environment_report.note: read only; it does not prove this process's environment

limitations: One fixed holdout, one seed and one run: no variance estimate, no significance statement; images of one case are not independent.

The preference among the four transfer candidates follows the pre-registered AUC rule on validation and is exploratory (one seed per configuration). Validation was used repeatedly for development and for checkpoint and candidate selection, so it is no independent assessment; the selection can lead to an optimistic assessment and its size was not determined.
The comparison is between whole pipelines; the earlier pipelines differ in architecture, pretraining, resolution and augmentation.
Training curves (flip, dropout) and validation curves (inference mode) are computed under different conditions.
The seed supports traceability; byte-identical GPU training runs are not promised.
Fine-tuning does not remove burned-in markers or device cues; whether they are used is not studied.
Scores are sigmoid outputs, not shown to be calibrated probabilities; the 0.5 threshold is a fixed convention.
Model choice and threshold for the test phase are not frozen here. Test data were not used.
